caption: The video captures an aerial view of a grass fire, where a bright orange-yellow curved fire line burns along dry tan grass on the left. This line encloses a darker, partly charred interior zone that remains largely unchanged. Grayish-white smoke drifts over the right half of the scene, constantly shifting and curling at its edges. The tongues of the curved fire line flicker, elongate, split, and merge continuously. A separate small flame patch at the bottom-right corner persists, its shape flickering and slightly changing size. Occasional glowing embers appear within the dark interior, indicating ongoing combustion.
